question: According to the Human Development Index (HDI) report, 2021-22, which country in the Indian subcontinent is the best performer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sri Lanka**__.

• **India’s rank** on the Human Development Index (HDI) has slipped from 130 in 2020 to **132 in 2022**, in line with a global fall in HDI scores in the wake of the Covid-19 pandemic.
 
• **"Uncertain Times, Unsettled Lives: Shaping our Future in a Transforming World"** was the **title **of the **HDR 2021-22.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Human Development Index (HDI)** is a statistical measure developed and coordinated by the **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)** to calculate the social and economic development levels of various nations.
 
• The Human Development Report (HDR) is a yearly report released by the UNDP as part of the Human Development Index.
 
• Since its** inception in 1990**, the Human Development Report (HDR) has been released annually with the **exception of 2012**.
 
• The** Human Development Index (HDI)** provides an overview of **average performance in three important dimensions** of human development:
 
 
• Living a long and healthy life (Life Expectancy)
 
• Knowledge (Education)
 
• A descent standard of living (Per Capita Income)
 
 
• The health dimension is evaluated based on life expectancy at birth indicated by Life expectancy index.
 
• The education dimension is measured by the mean number of years of schooling for individuals aged 25 and over, and the predicted years of schooling for children who are about to join school indicated by Education index.
 
• The gross national income per capita serves as a proxy for the standard of living indicated by GNI index.
 
 
 
 
 
• In the wake of the pandemic, and for the first time ever, the global Human Development Index (HDI) value declined—for two years straight.
